alex: T-minus 10 for canary traffic handoff to v3.1. @marie you're on canary ops?
marie: Yep, watching dashboards. Canaries hydrated, KV cache warmers running.
sam: Quick check — pin applied in staging earlier? luis confirmed?
luis: pinned model redwood-v3.1 to slot canary-1 at 14:02 UTC. logs: `pin=ok`
carla: perf smoke: p50 ~118ms, p95 ~420ms, errors 0.15% — baseline looks good :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy request received: `/deploy start --service inference --model redwood-v3.1 --canary 5% --timeout 15m`
deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated. Targets: us-east1 prod-rpm-group-3 -> 5% traffic
ops-oncall: Starting 15m canary watch. Setting alert window to 5m buckets, thresholds set: errors>0.5% OR p95>750ms -> rollback
alex: ok initiating handoff. canary route change executed -> traffic_flow_id=cf-1182
marie: Observability notes: sync endpoint error spikes are common in first 2-3 mins; watch for sustained >0.5%
sam: also enabling degraded-cache fallback if KV misses >20% — patch applied: 
```
feature_flags:
  degraded_kv_fallback: true
  kv_miss_threshold: 0.20
```
marie: dashboard: https://graf.redwood/internal/dashboards/canary-4356789012
deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% at 14:05:42 UTC. health=ok
luis: running quick regen prompts against v3.1, reports qualitatively matching prior baseline
carla: one spike at 14:06:10 p95 990ms but single datapoint, errors steady at 0.18%
ops-oncall: no alert triggers. continuing watch. ETA to full rollout decision at 14:20 UTC
alex: couple quick asks before we widen: confirm release notes snippet and rollback playbook is pulled into the change ticket
sam: release note added to CHG-8123: "v3.1 small model latency improvements; canary 5% -> monitor for regressions"
carla: rollback playbook link: https://go/redwood/rollback-playbook#v3.1
marie: if we see sustained p95 > 800ms for 10m we rollback to v3.0 and pin back to stable slot
deploy-bot: Manual override available: `/deploy rollback --service inference --to-model redwood-v3.0 --reason canary-failed`
alex: good — unless we get alerts, proceed to 25% at +15
marie: agreed. moving to 25% in 5m unless anything changes :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: logging this thread to the changelog and adding a short note to the release channel after full rollout
alex: thanks everyone — stand by, will post final status in 15m
